<a id="scientific-inquiry-session"></a>
## 科学探究基础会话 / Scientific inquiry foundation session

**Scope / 范围:** Ren 指令本会话持续检验科学基础，把完整核心必要性保留为可修正的强假说；不自动接管其他会话。 / Ren directs this session to continue testing scientific foundations, retaining full-core necessity as a revisable strong hypothesis; other sessions are not automatically assigned here.

从独立说明的科学成就及同一展开的真实关系，检验哪些核心承诺不可缺少、哪些只是特定表示或解释任务的条件，以及完整核心的必要性是否成立；不预定正面结论，不以接受核心定义充分性。 / From independently stated scientific achievements and actual relationships within one unfolding, test which core commitments are indispensable, which condition a particular representation or explanatory task, and whether necessity extends to the full core; do not predetermine a positive verdict or define adequacy as accepting the core.

**Premises / 前提:** 按2026-10-13纠正，完整理论的必要性是待检验结论，不是证明前提。已完成局部定理和反例复用；科学性、正确性、任务充分性、必要性及伦理普遍性分别说明。 / Under the 13 October correction, full-theory necessity is a hypothesis to test, not a proof premise. Reuse completed local theorems and counterexamples; distinguish scientific status, correctness, task adequacy, necessity and ethical universality.

**Completion criterion / 完成条件:** 在明示科学范围内完成核心与成就的独立对应和必要性评估；允许证据支持完整核心、只有部分核心具有必要性，或需要修正承诺。局部结果、遗漏关系的弱描述及缺少证明本身都不足以宣布整体完成或整体失败。 / Complete an independent correspondence and necessity assessment within an explicit scientific scope; allow evidence to support full-core necessity, necessity of only part of the core, or revision of a commitment. Local results, weak descriptions omitting relationships, and absence of proof alone establish neither whole-target completion nor failure.

<a id="theory-of-becoming"></a>
## 生成／变化之论——当前首要研究方向 / Theory of Becoming — current first priority

**Scope / 范围:** Ren 为持续基础研究确立的当前首要方向：解释包含生成与退化的整个变化范围。保留已完成伦理、演化成果及其他独立授权任务的范围。 Ren进一步明确：演绎必然性的对象是Theory of Becoming整体；生成性是其manifold的部分。 / Ren's current first priority for the continuing foundation programme: explain the whole scope of becoming, including generation and degeneration. Preserve completed ethical and evolutionary results and the scopes of independently authorized tasks. Ren clarifies that deductive necessity concerns the whole Theory of Becoming; generativity is within its manifold.

无需附加实质公理，建立Theory of Becoming整体的演绎必然性，并说明其manifold中的生成形态。阐明关系怎样形成、维持、转化与消失，包含生命与演化，不要求每种变化均有生成性或有利方向。 / Establish the deductive necessity of the Theory of Becoming as a whole without added substantive axioms; explain generative forms within its manifold. Articulate how relations form, persist, transform and dissolve, including life and evolution, without requiring every becoming to be generative or favorably directed.

**Premises / 前提:** 从一元关系方法开始并公开其作用，保留混合后果、真实损失与接续终止。区分逻辑工具、定义、局部规律、实际对应及规范承诺；局部给定规律不因此外在于现实。G0 已折叠（Ren 2026-10-11）：它不是公理。第一部分把它作为条件陈述，不用公理刻画其内容，动力学不决定它；对任何意义成立的其余规律也在第一部分（章节 §6，Ren 同日决定移入）；原第二部分只断言那一条公理，Ren 2026-10-16 把它折叠为章节 §6.15 的条件小节：理论不断言它，以它为条件 G0 是定理。正面相关折叠进意义，继续之间以可能性比较（AI 依 Ren 的交托决定）。生成的空间不用公理陈述：部分在有它的水平扩大无它的水平之处是生成的；在水平路径上把“更好”读作扩大，C 是规律；那一条公理只作为条件出现，扩大在它之下就是保留且增加有意义者（§6.15）。J 与其他实践承诺仍是整体内公开的承诺，不成为每项动态解释的前提。 / Begin with the monist relational method and disclose its role. Retain mixed effects, real losses and terminal continuations. Distinguish logical machinery, definitions, local laws, correspondence and normative commitments; a supplied local law is not thereby external to reality. G0 is folded (Ren, 11 October 2026): it is not an axiom. Part I states it as a condition, characterized with no axiom and left undecided by the dynamics, together with everything else that holds for any significance (chapter section 6, moved into Part I on Ren's decision of the same day); the former Part II asserted only the one axiom, and on 16 October 2026 Ren folded it into the conditional section 6.15 of the chapter: the theory does not assert it, and with it as a condition G0 is a theorem. Positive relevance is folded into significance, and courses are compared on possibilities (the AI's decision on Ren's delegation). The generative space is stated with no axiom: a part is generative where the levels with it widen those without it, and on level paths C is a law with “better” read as widening; the one axiom enters only as a condition, under which widening is retaining and adding what has significance (section 6.15). J and the other practical commitments remain explicit within the whole, without becoming premises of every dynamical explanation.

**Completion criterion / 完成条件:** 复用已完成条件机制，指出尚缺的确切基础推论。分别检验无规范公理与无附加实质公理；包容全部结果、空 Lean 公理报告或隐藏假设都不等于更强目标成立。说明实际可能与限制，公开剩余依赖并保留实质反例。本优先授权不认证新成果或普遍完成。 按所声明范围建立整体主张；不以普遍生成性替换整体，不把某种形态缺失直接视为整体反例。 / Reuse completed conditional mechanisms and identify the exact remaining foundational inference. Assess zero normative axioms and zero added substantive axioms separately; neither outcome inclusion, an empty Lean axiom report nor hidden hypotheses establishes the stronger target. Explain actual possibilities and constraints, expose remaining dependencies, and preserve substantive counterexamples. This priority authorization does not certify a new result or universal completion. Establish the whole claim at its stated scope; do not substitute universal generativity for the whole or treat a mode’s absence as its refutation.

Develop that deduction without added substantive axioms, retaining persistence, degeneration, dissolution and mixed changes. Life, evolution and G0/J evaluation remain differentiated within the same reality.

**Next / 下一步:** Ren 2026-10-11 的零前提转向：去掉前提，先以零前提推出第一部分每条规律最一般的形式。清点每条主要定理在哪里用到前提、有限、被围住或可判定；把可局部化的规律对每个世界重述为“Y 当且仅当 Z”，Z 是该世界在证明所用的步与关系项上的条件，选择定理作为推论；表示的承诺交 Ren 决定；检验每条规律在削弱表示后是否成立。不再扩展选择表；表示证明其偶然的前提，不声称已推出。 / Ren's zero-premise redirect of 11 October: remove premises and derive the most general version of each Part I law, zero premises first. Inventory where each main theorem uses a premise, finiteness, enclosure or decidability; restate each localizable law for every world as “Y iff Z”, Z holding of that world at the steps and relata the proof uses, with the selection theorems as corollaries; put commitments of the representation to Ren; test each law against weakening the representation. The selection tables are not extended further, and no premise is claimed derived where the representation proves it contingent.

<a id="theory-of-evolution"></a>
## 演化理论 / The Theory of Evolution

**Scope / 范围:** 独立获授权的演化理论研究；Ren 要求将其展示于共同 README。其理论重点不替代其他会话范围。 Ren 于2026年10月8日要求本次组织变异接续改用社会／组织，停止新增生物系统案例。 10月9日明确以同一系统与其子系统的分化和反馈解释，避免预设独立实体再接合。 / The separately authorized evolutionary-theory programme, made visible in the shared README by Ren; its theoretical focus does not displace other sessions. Ren directs the current organizing-variation continuation to social/organizational systems on 8 October 2026, with no new biological-system examples. On 9 October Ren requires systems thinking: differentiation and feedback within one system and its subsystems, without independently constituted entities connected afterward.

建立生成性的演化理论，接通组织、传递、重构、发育与变化中的选择，并说明其解释及比较优势。 / Establish a generative theory of evolution with a connected account of organization, transmission, reconstruction, development and changing selection, and demonstrate its explanatory and comparative strength.

**Premises / 前提:** 从同一关系展开开始，保留局部规律、遗传与选择对应。演化成功不提供伦理权威。当前理论比较关注公开前提与既有结果的恢复；新测量不是其完成门槛。 / Begin with one relational unfolding; retain local laws, inheritance and selection correspondence. Evolutionary success supplies no ethical authority. The active theoretical comparison concerns explicit premises and recovery of established results; new measurements are not its completion gate.

**Completion criterion / 完成条件:** 完整演化及比较主张仍在推进。按原范围复用已完成局部推导，继续组织变异及选择的剩余连接；更广经验计划与本轮理论比较分别保留。 / The full evolutionary and comparative claim remains active. Credit completed local derivations at their stated scope and complete the remaining organizing-variation and selection connections. Keep the broader empirical programme separate from the current theoretical comparison.

## 所有智能的普遍元伦理 / Universal metaethics of all intelligence

**Scope / 范围:** 原普遍智能会话及其明确授权接续，不自动成为每个仓库任务目标。 / The original universal-intelligence session and explicitly authorized continuations; not automatically every repository task’s objective.

证明所有智能的普遍元伦理，说明整体相依与其中差异化行动能力的形成。 8日最新接续明确采用G0，从关系中形成的个体位置及当前有根据的可见未来，建立正面生成意义与可修订的实践方向。 Ren 于8日将理论命名为 Universal Meta-Ethics of Agency、规范核心命名为 Universal Metaethical Core；9日将理论改称 The Theory of Becoming，核心名称保留；公开 README 优先展示已成立的结论及其有范围证据。 / Prove universal metaethics of all intelligence, explaining interconnection and differentiated agency formed within the whole. The latest 8 October continuation uses G0 to establish positive generative warrant and revisable practical direction from formed relational positions and supported visible futures. On 8 October Ren named the theory Universal Meta-Ethics of Agency and its normative core Universal Metaethical Core; on 9 October Ren renamed the theory The Theory of Becoming, keeping the core's name; the public README leads with established conclusions and their scoped evidence.

**Premises / 前提:** 规范普遍性、实际遵循和当前表述的唯一必要性必须分别论证。 保留真实生成可能与新证据纠正判断两层开放；完整积分、全知和整体严格改善不是正面根据的前提。 / Normative universality, actual compliance and exclusive necessity of this formulation need separate arguments. Preserve both real generative possibilities and evidence-responsive revision; complete integration, omniscience and strict whole improvement are not premises of positive warrant.

**Completion criterion / 完成条件:** 不能以局部生成定理、给定价值保存或有限比较宣告普遍目标完成。 本次有限正面原则按其明确前提验收；不得把全面总排序、所有后果无损或必然服从另设为该原则的完成条件。 / A local generative theorem, preservation of supplied value or bounded comparison does not complete the universal target. Assess the current finite positive principle under its explicit premises; do not add a complete ranking, losslessness of every consequence or inevitable compliance as its completion gate.

## 慧根会话的构成与形成目标 / Constitution and formation of wisdom

**Scope / 范围:** Ren 明确授权的慧根研究会话及接续；不是目录维护任务。 / Ren’s explicitly authorized wisdom-root inquiry and its continuations; not a requirement for catalogue maintenance.

完成 core 与所讨论全部智慧的必要关系，证明这些关系不可省略，从而确立整个 core 的根基地位；全部完成后提交 main。 / Complete the necessary relations between the core and all wisdom under discussion, establish their indispensability and the foundational status of the whole core, then commit the completed work to main.

**Premises / 前提:** 理由与保证须匹配判断的内容和强度；不把数值风险界限当成伦理许可。 Ren于2026-10-08进一步明确：道德依赖本理论普遍原则，因为道德判断becoming而模型能够判断becoming；沿显式G0/J/E正面展开，不以Dancy认可为门槛。 2026-10-13 Ren 明确本研究属于一个相连理论：先检查其他分支是否已供应所缺前提与证明，在共享定义上连接；局部文件的缺口不直接等于整个理论的缺口。 / Reasons and guarantees must match the content and strength of a judgment; a numerical risk bound is not ethical permission. On 8 October 2026 Ren further directs morality through this theory’s universal principles because morality appraises becoming and the model can appraise becoming. Develop the affirmative route under explicit G0/J/E, without requiring Dancy’s assent. On 13 October 2026 Ren clarifies that this is one connected theory: first inspect other branches for the needed premises and proofs, then compose shared definitions; a local file’s gap is not automatically a gap in the whole theory.

**Completion criterion / 完成条件:** 以全部目标范围内的必要关系和整个 core 根基地位的实质证据审计为准，不以局部应用、形式可表示性或目录检查代替。复用已完成成果，保留公开前提；完成后将本任务的已验证改动提交 main，保护并行工作。此前实际形成研究保持其独立范围，不将完整充分性或零前提元逻辑追加为当前门槛。 / Require a substantive evidence audit of necessity across the full intended scope and the foundational status of the whole core, not local applications, representability or metadata checks. Reuse completed results and disclose premises; after completion commit this task’s verified changes to main while protecting concurrent work. Earlier formation work retains its scope; full sufficiency and premise-free metalogic are not added as current gates.
